fullPassage: The laws and constants of physics and the fundamental forces in our universe have very precise forms and values. This means that, if they were only very slightly different, life would not have been possible. For instance, the precise value of gravity has enabled our universe to arise by permitting the aggregation of dust and gas particles to proto-stars around which planets later came to orbit, including the Earth around the Sun. If the value of the electron had been ever so slightly larger or smaller, chemistry, as we know it, would not have been possible and life, which is based on organic chemistry, could not have started. The universe was not designed for us to evolve, we have no privileged position in the universe; however, the laws and constants of physics allowed advanced life to evolve.

❌ ① random(무작위): 반대
❌ ③ changing(변하는): 반대
❌ ④ unknown(알려지지 않은): 문맥 부적합

questions.passage: The laws and constants of physics and the fundamental forces in our universe have very precise forms and values. This means that, if they were only very slightly different, life would not have been possible. For instance, the precise value of gravity has enabled our universe to arise by permitting the aggregation of dust and gas particles to proto-stars around which planets later came to orbit, including the Earth around the Sun. If the value of the electron had been ever so slightly larger or smaller, chemistry, as we know it, would not have been possible and life, which is based on organic chemistry, could not have started. The universe was not designed for us ____ evolve, we have no privileged position in the universe; however, the laws and constants of physics allowed advanced life ____.
questions.stem:
다음 한국어 문장을 영어로 완성하시오. (2단어)

"진보한 생명이 진화하도록 허용했다."
→ allowed advanced life __________. (영어로)

det.korean: allow + O + to V: 진보한 생명이 진화하도록(to evolve) 허용했다.
det.analysis: allow + 목적어 + to부정사 구조. evolve=진화하다.
det.tip: allow A to B = A가 B하도록 허용하다
